name: Data Exfiltration
description: Synthetic bulk data staging from the database through the application tier toward the internet. No real data — synthetic record counts only; defense cuts the egress path at the DMZ choke point.

attack_steps.description: Synthetic staging process starts on application server
Bulk synthetic record reads from database (10,000 synthetic rows)
Staged synthetic data forwarded to web server for egress
Attempted synthetic egress to internet gateway

invariant: Database cannot reach the internet; the egress path through the DMZ is segmented
